ro.text: Capela Ciumei din Imst a fost ridicată ca un monument religios în amintirea perioadelor de epidemie din trecut. Aceasta este o clădire istorică situată într-un punct proeminent al orașului.

ro.name: Kapuzinereremitage
ro.text: Schitul Capucinilor din Imst este un loc de retragere strâns legat de mănăstirea capucinilor. Acesta servește ca spațiu pentru rugăciune în liniște și pentru viața monahală simplă.

ro.name: Pitztalbrücke
ro.text: Podul Pitztal de lângă Imst este o construcție impresionantă care traversează valea Inn și permite legătura către Pitztal. Este considerat un exemplu semnificativ de inginerie modernă în regiune.

ro.name: Katharinenkapelle
ro.text: Capela Sfânta Ecaterina din Imst este o mică clădire sacră dedicată Sfintei Ecaterina. Se remarcă prin atmosfera sa intimă și stilul arhitectural istoric.

en.name: Speichersee Hoch Imst
en.text: The Speichersee Hoch Imst invites for relaxing walks and enjoying the alpine scenery.

en.name: Starkenberger See
en.text: The Starkenberger See in Imst is an idyllic body of water that invites for walks and relaxation.

en.name: Strader See
en.text: The Strader See in Imst offers a peaceful setting for nature observation and short hikes.

en.name: Kropfsee
en.text: The Kropfsee in Imst is a nature-oriented destination that invites for lingering by the water.

en.name: Spielplatz Volksschule Sonnberg
en.text: The playground of the Sonnberg primary school in Imst offers various opportunities for playing in the fresh air.

en.name: Indoorspielplatz Playtopia Imst
en.text: Playtopia Imst is an indoor playground offering weather-independent fun and action for children.

en.name: Spielplatz Gunglgrün
en.text: The Gunglgrün playground in Imst is a popular meeting point for families with children outdoors.

en.name: Hexengartle
en.text: The Hexengartle in Imst offers an imaginative environment for children to play and discover.

en.name: Spielplatz Sportzentrum Imst
en.text: The playground at the Imst sports center offers children space for movement and play after sports activities.

en.name: Spielplatz Imsterau
en.text: The Imsterau playground in Imst is a lovely spot in the greenery where children can play extensively.

en.name: Spielplatz Kindergarten
en.text: The kindergarten playground in Imst offers a protected and child-friendly environment for playing.

en.name: Spielplatz Oberstadt
en.text: The Oberstadt playground in Imst is centrally located and offers variety for little adventurers.

en.name: Spielplatz Pavillon
en.text: The playground at the pavilion in Imst invites for outdoor play in a pleasant atmosphere.

en.name: Schwimmbad Imst
en.text: An outdoor pool in Imst offering relaxation and water fun in the mountains.

en.name: Museum im Ballhaus
en.text: The Museum im Ballhaus in Imst displays extensive collections on city history and regional art. It is housed in a historic building that once served as a ballroom.

en.name: Fasnachtsmuseum
en.text: The Fasnachtsmuseum in Imst is dedicated to the tradition of the local carnival and the famous Schemenlaufen parade. Visitors can admire artistic masks and historic costumes of the region here.

en.name: Blue Cave
en.text: The Blue Cave near Imst is a significant archaeological site located in the natural rock landscape. It offers insights into the early settlement history of this alpine region.

en.name: Stadtbühne Imst
en.text: The Stadtbühne Imst is a central venue for theater performances and cultural presentations in the city. The venue offers a diverse program for residents and guests.

en.name: Pulverturm
en.text: The Pulverturm in Imst is a historic ruin that was once part of the old city fortifications. It stands as a stone witness to past defense systems in the landscape.

en.name: Langegg
en.text: Langegg is a well-known viewpoint near Imst that offers a wide view over the Inn Valley. Hiking trails lead visitors to this exposed spot in the midst of the Tyrolean mountains.

en.name: Wetterkreuz
en.text: The Wetterkreuz serves as a prominent viewpoint on a hill near the town of Imst. From here, you can enjoy the panorama of the surrounding peaks and valleys.

en.name: Wellingtontanne
en.text: The Wellingtontanne is a monumental tree in Imst, regarded as a natural monument due to its size and history. It is located in an accessible area and is a destination for nature enthusiasts.

en.name: Aussichtsterrasse
en.text: The viewing terrace in Imst offers visitors an excellent overview of the city center and the surrounding mountain landscape. It is an ideal spot for photographers and those seeking relaxation.

en.name: Kurzegg
en.text: Kurzegg is a viewpoint near Imst known for its impressive long-distance views. A trip there combines a short hike with a panoramic view of Tyrol.

en.name: Hinter Hochegg
en.text: Hinter Hochegg is an exposed viewpoint that can be reached via hiking trails from Imst. The location offers expansive views across the region's alpine landscape.

en.name: Alpine Coaster Imst
en.text: The Alpine Coaster in Imst is one of the world's longest summer toboggan runs, offering a fast ride through nature. The track is a popular destination for thrill-seekers and families.

en.name: Rosengartenschlucht
en.text: The Rosengartenschlucht in Imst is an impressive natural monument with waterfalls and steep rock walls. A well-maintained path leads visitors safely through this spectacular geological highlight.

en.name: Königskapelle
en.text: The Königskapelle in Imst is a historical monument erected in memory of the Saxon King Friedrich August II. It is located by the road and is known for its neo-Gothic architecture.

en.name: Kapelle Unser Herr im Elend
en.text: The chapel Unser Herr im Elend is a sacred building in Imst used for religious devotion. The building is an example of Baroque chapel architecture in the Tyrolean region.

en.name: Expositurkirche hll. Magdalena und Nikolaus
en.text: The Expositurkirche hll. Magdalena und Nikolaus is an important religious center within the city area of Imst. The church building houses noteworthy altars and artworks.

en.name: Kapuzinerkirche
en.text: The Capuchin Church in Imst is part of the local monastery and a place of silence and liturgy. The building is characterized by its simple architecture, typical of the Capuchin order.

en.name: Johanneskirche
en.text: The Johanneskirche in Imst is a sacred building that serves the Christian community as a house of worship. The church blends harmoniously into the historic cityscape of Imst.

en.name: Laurentiuskirche
en.text: The Laurentiuskirche is a significant religious site in Imst dedicated to Saint Lawrence. It is known for its artistic interior decoration and historical importance in the town.

en.name: Kirche zu den hl. Engeln
en.text: The Church of the Holy Angels in Imst is a place of worship dedicated to the spiritual community. The building impresses with its clear design and invites visitors to inner contemplation.

en.name: Pestkapelle
en.text: The Pestkapelle in Imst was built as a religious memorial in remembrance of past plague times. It stands as a historic building at a prominent point within the city area.

en.name: Kapuzinereremitage
en.text: The Capuchin Hermitage in Imst is a place of seclusion closely connected to the Capuchin monastery. It serves as a space for quiet prayer and simple monastic life.

en.name: Pitztalbrücke
en.text: The Pitztalbrücke near Imst is an impressive structure spanning the Inn Valley and providing access to the Pitztal. It is considered a significant example of modern engineering in the region.

en.name: Katharinenkapelle
en.text: The Katharinenkapelle in Imst is a small sacred building dedicated to Saint Catherine. It is characterized by its intimate atmosphere and historic construction.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Imst liegt im Tiroler Oberland an der Mündung des Gurgltals in das Inntal und ist für seine reiche Tradition und landschaftliche Schönheit bekannt. Die Siedlungsgeschichte reicht bis in die Bronzezeit zurück, wobei der Ort im Jahr 763 erstmals urkundlich erwähnt wurde. Im Mittelalter blühte Imst durch den Bergbau auf Silber und Blei auf, was der Stadt Wohlstand und prächtige Bürgerhäuser bescherte. Ein besonderes kulturelles Highlight ist das Imster Schemenlaufen, ein Fastnachtsbrauch, der zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe zählt. Die Stadt wird oft als 'Stadt der Brunnen' bezeichnet, da über 40 historische Brunnen das Stadtbild zieren. Neben der historischen Altstadt lockt die Rosengartenschlucht, ein beeindruckendes Naturdenkmal direkt im Stadtzentrum, zahlreiche Besucher an. Heute fungiert Imst als wichtiges schulisches und administratives Zentrum im Tiroler Oberland und ist ein beliebter Ausgangspunkt für alpine Sportarten.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Imst a tiroli Oberlandban, a Gurgltal és az Inn-völgy találkozásánál fekszik, gazdag hagyományairól és festői szépségéről ismert. A település története a bronzkorig nyúlik vissza, írásos forrásokban először 763-ban említik. A középkorban Imst az ezüst- és ólombányászat révén virágzott fel, ami jólétet és pompás polgárházakat hozott a városnak. Különleges kulturális esemény az Imster Schemenlaufen, egy farsangi szokás, amely az UNESCO világörökség része. A várost gyakran a 'kutak városának' is nevezik, mivel több mint 40 történelmi kút díszíti a városképet. A történelmi óváros mellett a Rosengartenschlucht szurdok, egy lenyűgöző természeti emlékmű közvetlenül a városközpontban, számos látogatót vonz. Ma Imst fontos oktatási és közigazgatási központ a tiroli Oberlandban, és kedvelt kiindulópontja az alpesi sportoknak.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Imst este situat în Tiroler Oberland, la gura de vărsare a văii Gurgltal în valea râului Inn, fiind cunoscut pentru tradițiile sale bogate și frumusețea peisajului. Istoria așezării datează din epoca bronzului, locul fiind menționat documentar pentru prima dată în anul 763. În Evul Mediu, Imst a înflorit datorită mineritului de argint și plumb, ceea ce a adus orașului prosperitate și case cetățenești magnifice. Un punct culminant cultural special este Imster Schemenlaufen, un obicei de carnaval care face parte din Patrimoniul Mondial UNESCO. Orașul este adesea supranumit 'orașul fântânilor', deoarece peste 40 de fântâni istorice decorează peisajul urban. Pe lângă centrul istoric, cheile Rosengartenschlucht, un monument natural impresionant chiar în centrul orașului, atrag numeroși vizitatori. Astăzi, Imst funcționează ca un centru educațional și administrativ important în Tiroler Oberland și este un punct de plecare popular pentru sporturile alpine.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Imst is located in the Tyrolean Oberland at the mouth of the Gurgl Valley into the Inn Valley and is renowned for its rich traditions and scenic beauty. Its settlement history reaches back to the Bronze Age, with the town first documented in the year 763. In the Middle Ages, Imst flourished through silver and lead mining, which brought prosperity and grand burgher houses to the community. A unique cultural highlight is the Imster Schemenlaufen, a traditional carnival custom recognized as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. The town is often called the 'City of Fountains' because more than 40 historic fountains adorn its streets. Besides the historical old town, the Rosengartenschlucht, a stunning natural monument located right in the town center, attracts numerous visitors. Today, Imst serves as a major educational and administrative hub in the Tyrolean Oberland and is a favored base for alpine sports.
descriptionAdvanced.es: Imst se encuentra en el Oberland tirolés, en la desembocadura del valle del Gurgl en el valle del Inn, y es conocida por su rica tradición y belleza paisajística. La historia del asentamiento se remonta a la Edad del Bronce, siendo el lugar mencionado por primera vez en 763. En la Edad Media, Imst floreció gracias a la minería de plata y plomo, lo que otorgó a la ciudad prosperidad y magníficas casas burguesas. Un punto cultural destacado es el 'Imster Schemenlaufen', una costumbre de carnaval que forma parte del Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial de la UNESCO. A menudo se llama a la ciudad la 'ciudad de las fuentes', ya que más de 40 fuentes históricas adornan el paisaje urbano. Además del casco antiguo histórico, el barranco de Rosengarten, un impresionante monumento natural directamente en el centro, atrae a numerosos visitantes. Hoy, Imst funciona como un importante centro escolar y administrativo en el Oberland tirolés y es un punto de partida popular para los deportes alpinos.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: Imst situa-se no Tiroler Oberland, na foz do vale Gurgltal no vale do Inn, e é conhecida pela sua rica tradição e beleza paisagística. A história do povoamento remonta à Idade do Bronze, tendo o local sido mencionado pela primeira vez em 763. Na Idade Média, Imst floresceu através da mineração de prata e chumbo, o que trouxe prosperidade à cidade e magníficas casas burguesas. Um destaque cultural especial é o 'Imster Schemenlaufen', um costume de carnaval que faz parte do Património Mundial da UNESCO. A cidade é frequentemente chamada de 'cidade das fontes', pois mais de 40 fontes históricas adornam a paisagem urbana. Além do centro histórico, a garganta Rosengartenschlucht, um impressionante monumento natural diretamente no centro da cidade, atrai inúmeros visitantes. Hoje, Imst serve como um importante centro escolar e administrativo no Tiroler Oberland e é um ponto de partida popular para desportos alpinos.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Imst se situe dans l'Oberland tyrolien, à l'embouchure de la vallée du Gurgl dans la vallée de l'Inn, et est réputée pour sa riche tradition et la beauté de ses paysages. L'histoire du peuplement remonte à l'âge du bronze, le lieu étant mentionné pour la première fois en 763. Au Moyen Âge, Imst connut son essor grâce à l'exploitation des mines d'argent et de plomb, ce qui apporta à la ville prospérité et magnifiques maisons bourgeoises. Un point fort culturel particulier est le « Imster Schemenlaufen », une coutume de carnaval classée au patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO. La ville est souvent surnommée la « ville des fontaines », car plus de 40 fontaines historiques ornent ses rues. Outre la vieille ville historique, les gorges du Rosengarten (Rosengartenschlucht), un monument naturel impressionnant situé directement au centre-ville, attirent de nombreux visiteurs. Aujourd'hui, Imst fait office de centre scolaire et administratif important dans l'Oberland tyrolien et constitue un point de départ prisé pour les sports alpins.

de: Imst wurde erstmals im Jahr 763 als Oppidum Humiste urkundlich erwähnt.
Das Schemenlaufen wurde 2012 in die UNESCO-Liste des immateriellen Kulturerbes aufgenommen.
Die Stadt beherbergt über 40 historische Brunnen, viele davon mit Heiligenfiguren.
Die Rosengartenschlucht ist ein 1,5 km langer geologischer Lehrpfad im Stadtgebiet.
Imst liegt auf einer Seehöhe von 827 Metern.
Das erste SOS-Kinderdorf der Welt wurde 1951 in Imst von Hermann Gmeiner gegründet.
hu: Imstet először 763-ban említik Oppidum Humiste néven.
A Schemenlaufen 2012-ben került fel az UNESCO szellemi kulturális örökség listájára.
A városban több mint 40 történelmi kút található, sokuk szobrokkal díszített.
A Rosengartenschlucht egy 1,5 km hosszú geológiai tanösvény a város területén.
Imst 827 méteres tengerszint feletti magasságban fekszik.
A világ első SOS Gyermekfaluját 1951-ben alapította Hermann Gmeiner Imstben.
ro: Imst a fost menționat documentar pentru prima dată în anul 763 sub numele de Oppidum Humiste.
Obiceiul Schemenlaufen a fost inclus în 2012 pe lista Patrimoniului Cultural Imaterial UNESCO.
Orașul găzduiește peste 40 de fântâni istorice, multe dintre ele decorate cu figuri de sfinți.
Cheile Rosengartenschlucht reprezintă un traseu geologic lung de 1,5 km în zona orașului.
Imst este situat la o altitudine de 827 de metri.
Primul sat de copii SOS din lume a fost fondat în Imst în 1951 de Hermann Gmeiner.
en: Imst was first documented in the year 763 as Oppidum Humiste.
The Schemenlaufen carnival was added to the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2012.
The town is home to over 40 historic fountains, many featuring religious figures.
The Rosengartenschlucht is a 1.5 km long geological trail within the town limits.
Imst is situated at an elevation of 827 meters above sea level.
The world's first SOS Children's Village was founded in Imst in 1951 by Hermann Gmeiner.
